targets.statement: Drivers must always yield to trains because a fifty-five-mile-per-hour train needs a mile or more to stop, every car-train crash is the motorist's fault, nearly half occur at crossings equipped with lights, bells, or gates, two-thirds happen in daylight, impatient motorists try to beat waits averaging thirty seconds to two minutes, and negligent motorists cross without looking, listening, or stopping, mostly within twenty-five miles of home.
